designSummary: Descriptive evidence map of charted data; no pooling across engagement definitions.
sampleSize: Not a sample: every eligible report is included. The library's preliminary count suggests about 900 titles and 80 to 120 full texts; at about two minutes per title per reviewer, dual title screening takes about 60 hours in total, which fits six reviewer-hours a week over the first ten weeks.
primaryAnalysis: Frequency tables of engagement definitions and measures by study design and year; a chart of reported engagement levels against time since install.
secondaryAnalysis: Tables of features and clinician support in reports with engagement beyond three months; outcomes reported alongside engagement, labelled as associations; offer, install and exclusion counts by age, income and disability where reported.
missingData: Items not reported are charted as not reported and counted, never inferred.
multiplicity: No hypothesis tests; all results descriptive.
software: Reference manager for screening and a spreadsheet charting form with a data dictionary.
overfittingGuards: Outcomes never presented as effects of engagement
Charting items fixed after testing on seven records
summary: Descriptive map aligned with the PCC question; workload sized from the library's preliminary counts.
